pages.title: A Challenging Journey Awaits
pages.text: Welcome to $(mod_name) — a hardcore survival experience built on the MITE framework. $(br2)This world is $(important)not kind$(). Villages are gone, resources are scarce, and every step forward must be earned through your own efforts.

pages.title: Your First Steps
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Look around your spawn point for a $(item)chest$() containing a $(item)Spyglass$() — your first memento and the key to unlocking progress.$(br2)$(bold)2.$() Mine $(item)gravel$() to find $(item)Flint Shards$() or a whole $(item)Flint$().$(br2)$(bold)3.$() Craft a $(item)Flint Hatchet$() to begin felling trees.$(br2)$(note)The Spyglass in the starter chest triggers your first advancement — don't miss it!$()

pages.title: Where to Go Next
pages.text: After securing your basic tools, explore these chapters to deepen your understanding of the world.
